parse.title: freír
parse.text:
See also: freir and Freir

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Old Spanish friir (with dissimilation), from Latin frīgere (with a change in verb class), from Proto-Indo-European *bʰer-.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /fɾeˈiɾ/ [fɾeˈiɾ]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -iɾ
  • Syllabification: fre‧ír

Verb

[edit]

freír (first-person singular present frío, first-person singular preterite freí, past participle freído or frito)

  1. to fry
    Synonym: fritar
